policyMappings.select: Surge select / QX static / Clash select / Loon select (native)
policyMappings.fallback: Surge fallback / QX available / Clash fallback / Loon fallback (native)
policyMappings.urlTest: Native Surge, Clash and Loon url-test; QX normally uses url-latency-benchmark, but falls back to available for remote sources or node regex filters because those regex options are not documented for benchmark groups
policyMappings.loadBalance: Surge, Clash and Loon use native load-balance; QX falls back to round-robin (approximate, balancing algorithms may differ)
policyMappings.subnet: Native in Surge; Clash and Loon fall back to select (approximate; default and subnet-rule policies become candidates); unsupported in QX
policyMappings.smart: Native Surge smart; Clash and Loon fall back to latency testing; QX uses url-latency-benchmark without node filters and available with remote sources or node regex filters (all approximations lose adaptive quality semantics)
policyMappings.roundRobin: Native in QX; Surge, Clash and Loon fall back to load-balance (approximate)
policyMappings.destHash: QX normally uses native dest-hash, but falls back to round-robin for remote sources or node regex filters; Surge persistent load-balance / Clash consistent-hashing / Loon load-balance are approximate
policyMappings.ssid: Native in Quantumult X; Loon output is retained only for compatibility with the legacy official example because the current policy-group manual omits it (verify the client version); Clash falls back to select (approximate; network conditions are not preserved); unsupported in Surge
policyMappings.surgeOnly: Surge only; Quantumult X, Clash and Loon generation report a diagnostic instead of guessing a mapping

configGenerator.includeOtherGroupsFallbackHelp: Surge expands proxies from the selected groups. Quantumult X, Clash and Loon are not assumed to have an equivalent flattening feature, so generation applies a diagnosed fallback or omits it per target. A normal policy-group member still means using that whole group as one candidate.
configGenerator.selectSubnetDefaultHelp: Choose the policy used when no subnet rule matches. Quantumult X currently has no safe subnet fallback.
configGenerator.policySelectionHelp: Search and select multiple groups without expanding a long list in the form.
configGenerator.noAvailablePolicyGroupsHelp: Create another policy group first, or change the current search.
configGenerator.ruleNameHelp: Quantumult X uses this as the filter_remote tag, Clash uses it as the rule-provider name, Loon uses it as the Remote Rule tag, and Surge ignores it.

health.title: Configuration health check
health.description: Check rule, policy-group, remote-source and rule-set references and compatibility across four clients.
health.runningDescription: Running static checks for Surge, Quantumult X, Clash and Loon configuration rules.
health.genericSuggestion: Open the matching editor section, correct the field, then run the health check and target preview again.
health.notFoundDescription: The project may have been deleted or renamed. Return to the list and choose it again.
health.failedDescription: The health check could not be completed. Check the backend state and try again.
health.allClearTitle: No issues in the selected scope
health.allClearDescription: Rule references and client compatibility passed the current static checks.

coverage.title: These items are not verified online by the static health check
coverage.description: The health check does not download remote bodies, generate real nodes or execute response transformers, so it does not change the project or trigger upstream requests. Verify these items with generation previews and the actual clients.

PROJECT_INVALID.title: Project configuration is incomplete
PROJECT_INVALID.suggestion: Open the project editor, correct the required field, format or number at the reported path, then run the health check again.

POLICY_REFERENCE_INVALID.title: Policy-group reference is invalid
POLICY_REFERENCE_INVALID.suggestion: Change the reference to DIRECT, REJECT, or an existing enabled group; otherwise create or re-enable the intended policy group.

POLICY_GROUP_UNSUPPORTED.title: The target client does not support this group type
POLICY_GROUP_UNSUPPORTED.suggestion: Use a group type supported by the target. Prefer select, url-test, or fallback when identical four-client behavior is required.

POLICY_GROUP_FALLBACK.title: The policy group needs a compatibility fallback
POLICY_GROUP_FALLBACK.suggestion: Use a portable group type for identical behavior, or review and accept the documented fallback in the target preview.

POLICY_GROUP_EMPTY.title: The policy group has no usable members
POLICY_GROUP_EMPTY.suggestion: Add DIRECT, REJECT, another enabled group, explicit proxies, all proxies, or a compatible remote proxy source.

POLICY_GROUP_CYCLE.title: Policy groups contain a reference cycle
POLICY_GROUP_CYCLE.suggestion: Remove one group-to-group reference so the policy dependency graph cannot loop back to itself.

POLICY_REGEX_INVALID.title: The node-filter regular expression is invalid
POLICY_REGEX_INVALID.suggestion: Correct the regular expression or remove the filter, and verify that the expression compiles before saving.

REMOTE_SOURCE_INVALID.title: The remote proxy source is unavailable or incompatible
REMOTE_SOURCE_INVALID.suggestion: Choose an existing enabled source in the target format, or enable automatic Sub-Store conversion with a reachable public URL.

REMOTE_SOURCE_FALLBACK.title: The remote proxy source needs a conversion fallback
REMOTE_SOURCE_FALLBACK.suggestion: Use a target-native or automatic source for exact behavior, or confirm the parser fallback in the target preview.

RULE_SET_INVALID.title: The rule set cannot be used by the target client
RULE_SET_INVALID.suggestion: Choose an existing enabled rule set that produces the target format. Plugin rule sets also require a valid public delivery URL.

RULE_SET_FALLBACK.title: The rule set needs compatibility conversion
RULE_SET_FALLBACK.suggestion: Use a target-native rule set for exact semantics, or inspect the converted preview before keeping this fallback.

RULES_INCOMPLETE.title: Rule order or catch-all behavior is incomplete
RULES_INCOMPLETE.suggestion: Keep FINAL as the last active rule and add a final policy when consistent catch-all behavior is required.

DUPLICATE_ENTRY.title: Duplicate configuration found
DUPLICATE_ENTRY.suggestion: Remove or rename the duplicate so sources, policy members and rules do not become ambiguous or match twice.

UNUSED_ENTRY.title: This configuration entry is currently unused
UNUSED_ENTRY.suggestion: Delete it if obsolete, or reference it from an active rule or policy group when it is still intentional.

INDEPENDENT_CONFIG_INVALID.title: Independent configuration syntax is invalid
INDEPENDENT_CONFIG_INVALID.suggestion: Correct the target-specific syntax. Clash independent configuration must be a YAML object.

TARGET_OPTION_OMITTED.title: The target client will ignore this option
TARGET_OPTION_OMITTED.suggestion: Move the behavior into the target independent configuration, or remove the target-specific option when portability matters more.

TARGET_DIAGNOSTIC.title: The target client has a compatibility notice
TARGET_DIAGNOSTIC.suggestion: Open the target preview and adjust the related group, rule, source, or client-specific option.
